title: Chicken piccata with lemon sauce and courgette
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water. Halve the chicken horizontally and flatten it, season with salt and pepper and dust with flour.
Beat the egg with the Parmesan, dip the chicken in it and fry in the oil for 3 minutes per side until golden, then keep warm.
Slice the courgettes and fry in the same pan for 4 minutes, then remove.
Add the stock, lemon juice and butter to the pan and reduce for 2 minutes.
Arrange the chicken with the courgettes and pasta, pour over the sauce and sprinkle with parsley.
